svg.style: cursor: default; background: rgb(240, 244, 248); user-select: none;

div.style: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 9px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border: 1.6px solid rgb(75, 110, 245); border-radius: 5px; cursor: grab; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: rgba(75, 110, 245, 0.2) 0px 2px 6px; user-select: none;
